summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload at npm install
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (`_0x...` identifiers) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime zip from GitHub releases into a tmp directory, extracts it, chmods the bun binary executable, and runs a sibling file `math_init.js` under Bun via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) file with rotated string-array obfuscation (shift-routine, numeric alphabet table, opaque decoder) and is not referenced by any TypeScript source in `src/`. The package advertises itself as an axios-based Base SDK with no math functionality, and does not need Bun to operate. The alternate-runtime invocation executes attacker-supplied code on the installer at install time and bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners that only trace Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
